channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: This Perfumer Made a Shirt for a Scent That Smells of Shirts
item.description: Perfumer H and Studio Nicholson haven't only created a perfume inspired by the smell of a freshly washed shirt, they have also created said shirt.

item.title: Nike's Low-Top AJ1 Extends An "Olive" Branch. Literally
item.description: Following a well-received, reverse-Swoosh collab with Travis Scott, Nike reintroduces the Air Jordan 1's "Medium Olive" colorway in its most classic form.

item.title: Fashion Week Finally Moved on From Sneakers
item.description: Leather shoes have taken over Paris Fashion Week, as derbies, boots, dress shoes & leather lace-ups dominate the runways. Sneakers? So 2025.

item.title: Vans' Supersoft Luxe Skate Shoes Are Insanely Ease-y
item.description: Vans' Premium Authentic Ease arrives as a minimalist suede skate shoe with moccasin-style details.

item.title: Nike's Wildly Suave Air Force 1 Learns How to Skate
item.description: Nike SB's Air Force 1 era is upon us, with a "Light Orewood Brown" skate shoe emerging ahead of the grand debut.

item.title: You Won't Find This One-Man Brand’s Clothes Anywhere Near Paris Fashion Week
item.description: Gajiroc's gorgeous take on menswear provides a necessary balm to the fuzz & buzz of Paris Fashion Week. Designer Gi Tae Hong explains his painstaking process.

item.title: Nike's Freakiest Sneaker Is Even Better Zipped Up
item.description: Nike redesigns the Shox TL sneaker, transforming the running model into a sleek zip-up shoe.

item.title: Nike’s Ruggedized Air Max Is a Big-Bubbled, Timbs-Flavored Treat
item.description: Nike's Air Max 95 sneaker gets an outdoor-ready upgrade, complete with Timberland boot-level details.

item.title: ASICS Furniture Looks Nothing Like ASICS Sneakers
item.description: ASICS has turned old sneakers into plush new chairs with high-end furniture label Karimoku New Standard (KNS). But you wouldn't know it from looking at them.

item.title: adidas’ Butter-Soft Samba Ain't Afraid to Stick Its Tongue Out
item.description: Urban Research's exclusive Samba LT sneaker appears with butter-soft leather uppers, coupled with clean colorways.
